changes.value: A creature comes into contact with an Electrified Fence.
Each round at the start of the target's turn, as long as the target remains exposed to the Electrified Fence.

Acrobatics (DC 21): The character tumbles away from the Electrified Fence, gaining a +5 circumstance bonus to Reflex Defense to avoid the Hazard. Jump (DC 26): The character leaps over the Electrified Fence without taking damage.

system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions

See also: Hazards

The metal fence before you crackles with energy.

This Hazard can be as simple as an electrified chain-link fence, or it can take forms such as a powered metal wall, a series of lethal laser beams spanning the gap between relay posts, or a force field that seals off a particular area up to a certain height. Combatants can use the Hazard to keep their opponents at bay while firing at them from relative safety. The Hazard can also keep creatures confined to a specific area and prevent them from fleeing.

Electrified Fence Statistics (CL 5)

Keywords: Artificial, Contact, Energy

Trigger: A creature comes into contact with an Electrified Fence.

Attack: +7 vs Reflex Defense

Recurrence: Each round at the start of the target's turn, as long as the target remains exposed to the Electrified Fence.

Suggested Skills: The following are suggested Skills for this Hazard:

  • Acrobatics (DC 21): The character tumbles away from the Electrified Fence, gaining a +5 circumstance bonus to Reflex Defense to avoid the Hazard.
  • Jump (DC 26): The character leaps over the Electrified Fence without taking damage.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
